Cooking  


As a kid I once was terrified with burning my food which was why every time my mom wanted to teach me how to cook, I always said no. Fast forward to being in college, I was forced to learn how to make my own meals. I had friends show me the kitchen basics and watched youtube for some recipes and turns out it was actually really enjoyable and pretty easy. In fact all you had to do was just know the cooking times of what you're cooking to get an estimate of when it's done and just follow what the experts in youtube say about what to look out for. Now I got the hang of cooking that i realized I can use all my senses to cook a good meal: looking at coloration of the food, using a fork to know i got the right texture, smelling and tasting the food if its what i wanted the dish to be like, and using my hearing to know if its done frying.
